bio.text: Brett Lindstrom, a former state senator from Omaha, served in the Nebraska Legislature from 2015 to 2023, and lost the 2022 Republican primary for governor to Jim Pillen.

After a nonpartisan petition bid for governor was rejected for lacking enough valid signatures in August 2026, he became the America First Party's nominee for governor on September 1, according to the Nebraska Examiner.
He was born in Lincoln and has a bachelor's degree in history from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln.

sources.title: Lindstrom launches petition drive to qualify nonpartisan bid for Nebraska governor
Update: Lindstrom reports $16,049.50 spent in 2026 NE gubernatorial campaign
